messages:
nora: Heads-up — infra audit found admin-role drift in proj-billing. ~18 principals have owner/editor bindings with no custodian tag. I uploaded a CSV and sketched an "escrow" remediation: 48h self-attest, 7d escrow (limited owner privileges), then 90d archive if still unclaimed. Need owners and ack.

gabe: ack. Could you paste the exact queries you ran? i'll run in staging before prod.

nora: quick commands i used:
```
# list owner/editor bindings (GCP)
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("owner|roles/owner|roles/editor"))'

# list KMS key IAM (GCP)
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --format='csv(name,labels)' | while read k l; do gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy $k --location=global --keyring=$KR --format=json; done

# AWS key policy quick
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' --output text | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-policy --key-id {} --profile prod || true
```

sam: running nightly scan now and uploaded CSV: gs://redwood-security/escrow/3420012345-drift.csv (18 rows). sample: svcacct-billing-ingest@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com, owner_tag=null; key-payments-legacy, labels=null

infra-bot: infra:pr_created repo=infra-owners pr=1502 add_entries=["svcacct-billing-ingest:unassigned","key-payments-legacy:unassigned"]

nora: escrow proposal (short):
- 48h: self-attest link -> forms.redwood.com/self-attest/escrow
- 7d escrow: annotate resource `escrow:active`, reduce owner perms to `roles/editor` or conditional owner via IAM Conditions, revoke console-level owner tokens; create an escrow-SA with minimal rights to avoid outages and bind it temporarily to approved services only
- 90d archive: snapshot config + key material to gs://redwood-security/archives/3420012345/ before any destructive action

gabe: +1 to escrow-SA idea. also we should gate new owner bindings in infra: deny PRs that add `roles/owner` without an entry in `infra/owners.yaml` and CODEOWNERS signoff. i'll open a PR for the gate.

sam: added provisional owners in sheet: svcacct-billing-ingest -> @gabe, key-payments-legacy -> @nora. i'll open infra PR to persist these owners and add `escrow:pending` labels.

nora: playbook snippets I added to runbook: how to create escrow-SA, commands to downgrade owner perms, proof-of-rotation artifact path `gs://redwood-security/rotations/3420012345/`, and terraform example to populate owner metadata. Short snippet: 
```
# downgrade owner binding (GCP example)
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT --member='serviceAccount:svcacct@example.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/owner' && gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT --member='serviceAccount:svcacct@example.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/editor'
```

retention-bot: retention:policy_check snapshot_required=yes snapshot_days=365 note="Archive snapshot retained 1yr minimum; 2yr if customer data involved"

attest-bot: attestation:run_complete ts=3420012678 status=partial_orphans=18 report=gs://redwood-security/escrow/3420012345-report.json

nora: thanks. follow-ups: (1) @gabe open infra PR for gating (2) @sam persist owners + outreach emails (3) i'll send escrow self-attest email and start 48h timer. reconvene if >10 unclaimed after escrow. :calendar:
